decision_tools.name: analyze_decision
decision_tools.description: Submit a finite decision-observability analysis (enumerated rational hypotheses with decision labels, declared linear views, bounded noise, optional observations). Creates a job under the caller's own contract permissions; never spends. Returns the job id; read it with decision_status.

decision_tools.name: decision_status
decision_tools.description: A decision analysis or acquisition job: state, disclosure-policed projection (counts, conclusion: separated within these assumptions / ambiguous / missing evidence / unsupported), verifications, assurance statements, acquisition plans. Private witnesses are NOT returned here. Read-only.

decision_tools.name: preview_acquisition
decision_tools.description: The next useful measurement set under a budget for an ambiguous decision: selected views, costs, predicted remaining ambiguities, exact / unsupported status. Nothing is stored, reserved or purchased. Read-only.

decision_tools.name: create_acquisition_contract
decision_tools.description: CONSEQUENTIAL: store the acquisition plan and freeze decision-evidence-acquisition work terms from it, opening a request for offers. Needs work:request and contract:freeze on the caller's grant; an analysis-only grant is refused by the server. Nothing is reserved until an award (award_work).

decision_tools.name: assurance_preview
decision_tools.description: Required assurance of an award milestone with the available evidence, satisfied and missing clauses and the next checks, in plain English. Read-only.

decision_tools.name: sampling_plan_preview
decision_tools.description: Exact finite-population sampling plan for an itemwise job: the smallest sample meeting C(N-m,k)/C(N,k) <= alpha, or infeasible with the required budget. The defect count m is an assumption of the claim, not an observation. Preview only (nothing bound). Read-only.

decision_tools.name: compare_portfolios
decision_tools.description: Paired comparison of verification portfolios on a named preregistered fault suite (dev split by default): false acceptance / rejection, abstention, cost and latency by failure family; suite coverage separate from any statistical rate. Runs synthetic cases under the caller's grant; no purchase.
